name: ending
description: The ending, played out: twenty-four enemy tanks appear next to the player's command centre on Big Arena and raze the base, so the match is lost. The real ending is on (match_end): the HUD goes, the camera holds on the deciding blow under a DEFEAT banner in slow motion, then the results come up with kills and losses. Checks the match_end and ending events, the end state the harness reports and that the enemy was credited with kills. Screenshots: one during the hold, one with the results up.
